threats.threat: drift evaluation data influences adaptation or topology
threats.mitigation: separate seed-addressed arrays and call boundaries; drift holdout is passed only to post-adaptation evaluation

threats.threat: checkpoint substitution or corruption preserves a weak identity
threats.mitigation: canonical full-field payload, SHA-256 payload identity, strict parser, full restored measurement comparison, and deliberate mutations
threats.residual_status: no signing, authorization, protected custody, or operational rollback

threats.threat: split metadata misstates sibling or descendant generation
threats.mitigation: capture original generation before reseeding and test sibling, descendant, uniqueness, reuse, and deterministic topology invariants
threats.residual_status: lineage identity is deterministic development metadata, not an external attestation

threats.threat: expert-equivalence is reported as exact planning success
threats.mitigation: separate exact world state, goal expert, path, regret, disconnection, transition error, and aliasing measurements
threats.residual_status: bounded synthetic planning is not real-world planning evidence

threats.threat: assurance digest is stale, incomplete, reordered, or omits source
threats.mitigation: machine-generated ordered manifest with per-file hashes, framed aggregate digest, shard discovery, and independent verification
threats.residual_status: repository-local verification is not protected or independent custody

threats.threat: favorable seed or regime selection hides failures
threats.mitigation: eight frozen seeds and regimes, all-trials pass rule, per-trial failures, variance, and no seed removal
threats.residual_status: the bounded matrix is not representative of arbitrary environments

threats.threat: poisoning, replay removal, malformed data, or capacity boundaries fail silently
threats.mitigation: negative tests with declared reject, fallback, fail-gate, UNKNOWN, or non-promotion dispositions
threats.residual_status: the attacks are bounded fixtures, not a complete adversarial evaluation
